Landing.heroDescription: One tool to manage your sunbeds, take bookings, and accept payments. Set up your sunbeds, products and services here, and start taking reservations in minutes. Simple for you, easy for your guests.
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to run your venue
Landing.featuresSubtitle: From sunbed inventory to payment settlement
Landing.feature1Desc: Drag-and-drop sunbed layout with satellite map overlay. Configure parcels, rows, and pairing.
Landing.feature2Desc: See bookings per hour and per day. Never oversell — availability updates in real time.
Landing.feature3Desc: Accept card payments via Stripe. Automated invoicing, VAT handling, and transparent settlements.
Landing.feature4Desc: Guests get a QR pass after booking. Staff scan to validate — no paper tickets needed.
Landing.feature5Desc: Sell food, drinks, and accessories. Guests order from their phone, you fulfill from the bar.
Landing.feature6Desc: Generate time-limited access tokens for on-site staff. Control who sees what, and when.
Landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you grow.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to modernize your beach business?
Landing.ctaBody: Join venues across the Mediterranean already using Sunbnb to manage reservations, inventory, and payments.
